findings.claim: Enabling SGR mouse tracking removes wterm's documented native text-selection path.
findings.evidence: Exact-HEAD built InputHandler with modes 1000/1006 emitted ESC[<4;1;1M and prevented a cancelable Shift+left mousedown; current xterm reserves Shift for forced selection while mouse reporting is active.
findings.layer: built DOM event and browser-selection contract
findings.path: MouseEvent mousedown -> InputHandler.handleMouse -> preventDefault/onData versus native DOM selection

findings.claim: A click that refocuses a mode-1004 terminal reports mouse press/release before focus.
findings.evidence: A blurred exact-HEAD built WTerm drive observed ESC[<0;1;1M, ESC[<0;1;1m, then ESC[I because mouse emits on mousedown/up while the hidden textarea is focused only by the later click handler.
findings.path: element mousedown/mouseup -> InputHandler.onData; element click -> textarea focus -> mode-1004 onData

findings.claim: A fixed-column terminal inside a wider CSS root reports a smaller column than the rendered cell under the pointer.
findings.evidence: With 80 rendered columns spanning 800px inside a 1000px root, exact-HEAD built InputHandler mapped x=395 to column 32 instead of rendered column 40 because it divides root content width by getCols().
findings.path: root content-box geometry -> InputHandler.handleMouse -> SGR column

findings.claim: Browser Back/Forward mouse buttons are encoded and captured as left clicks.
findings.evidence: Exact-HEAD built InputHandler received MouseEvent button=3/buttons=8 and emitted ESC[<0;1;1M because the button classifier falls through to zero; current xterm rejects buttons beyond the supported set.
findings.path: MouseEvent.button -> InputHandler ternary classifier -> SGR button code/capture

findings.claim: The fd90ba1 padding, iframe capture, multi-button capture, invalid-press, Ghostty parity, or documentation findings remain at exact HEAD.
findings.evidence: All ten committed input-mouse tests, Ghostty real-WASM tests, documentation surfaces, and exact fd90ba1-to-HEAD diff were rechecked; the only later change deletes the duplicated DOM README paragraph.

findings.claim: React and Vue source files require independent mouse/focus changes.
findings.evidence: Both wrappers delegate to WTerm/TerminalCore without a separate input encoder, and their tests/type-checks pass.

findings.claim: The remaining DEC mouse protocol subset needs explicit follow-up.
findings.evidence: The PR body explicitly leaves 1003, 1005, and 1015 unsupported; issue #55 remains open and Ghostty internally parses a wider set than the public adapter exposes.

findings.claim: Mouse/focus behavior lacks real-browser E2E coverage.
findings.evidence: Existing E2E tests cover rendering, keyboard, focus, cursor, scrollback, and resize but no DEC mouse reporting; no connected browser was available for this run.

exemptions.evidence: Every neighboring root README feature bullet uses the same punctuation, establishing repository prose style.

exemptions.claim: Docs navigation and page-title maps need no change.

exemptions.evidence: Optionality preserves source compatibility, absence safely disables the feature, and both first-party cores implement the accessors.

issue_candidates.title: Support DEC 1003/1005/1015/1016 or maintain an explicit subset contract
issue_candidates.evidence: The PR explicitly leaves 1003/1005/1015 unsupported; issue #55 remains open and Ghostty parses a wider set than the public adapter exposes.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: The PR declares a limited 1000/1002/1004/1006 subset.

issue_candidates.title: Add real-browser DEC mouse/focus E2E coverage
issue_candidates.evidence: Current E2E tests have no DEC mouse reporting and jsdom cannot fully validate native selection, capture, CSS geometry, or wheel behavior.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: This is durable cross-browser coverage beyond the four concrete source fixes required in PR #107.
